exposure: Maternal benzodiazepine receptor agonist (BZRA) exposure (preconception, first trimester, second trimester, third trimester)
cohort: The cohort comprised 170,144 pregnant individuals exposed to BZRA and 1,098,172 unexposed individuals, sourced from Taiwan's National Health Insurance database.
finding: Maternal BZRA exposure, particularly during the second trimester, was significantly associated with an increased risk of several adverse pregnancy and neonatal outcomes, including stillbirth, preterm birth, low birth weight, Apgar score < 7, and congenital malformations.
mod_finding: Maternal BZRA exposure was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery across all trimesters, with the highest risk observed during the second trimester.
